phone.changelog: Adds companion support and diagnostics for Watch multi-tier battery saving system, including Extreme Saver and Super Extreme Emergency modes.

watch.changelog: Adds multi-tier Battery Saver system: Extreme Saver (3x stamina, 1 Hz ticks, relaxed optical sensors, PHONE CONNECTION KEPT ALIVE) and Super Extreme Saver (8+ days emergency standby, stops Bluetooth RF, minimal OLED emergency clock with 1-tap exit). Added Battery & Power settings screen with live stamina estimation.
